# Retrieve the latest hotel results from cache

# Apply the new amenity filters: room service and shuttle service

    has_room_service=True,
    airport_shuttle_present=True
)

# Save the updated hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_final", value=filtered_hotels)

# Retrieve the latest restaurant results from cache

# Apply the new amenity filters: room service and shuttle service

    prior_results=restaurants,
    has_room_service=True,
    airport_shuttle_present=True
)

# Save the updated restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants_final", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Perform a nearest search to find restaurants near the filtered hotels

    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=filtered_restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Print a summary of the results
print(f"Found {len(nearest_results['search_results'])} restaurants near hotels with room service and shuttle service.")
